added.description:
Discover What’s Possible At BetMGM

Ready to make your career legendary? Join us as we bring the magic of Vegas to our players. The BetMGM team has over 1,400 talented members, revolutionizing sports betting and online gaming in the United States and Canada. We’re a brand with technology at our hearts and the most driven and focused talent in the business.

Benefits

As a valued team member, we’re committed to giving you the resources and support you need to thrive. Our benefits and perks include:

Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance
401(k) with company match
Pre-tax spending accounts including health care FSA and commuter savings
Flexible paid time off
Professional development reimbursement and ongoing skills training opportunities
Employee resource groups
Swag, ticket giveaways, and more!

At BetMGM, we recognize that every individual plays a meaningful role in our success. That’s why we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive workplace. It’s the strategy behind every win. By meeting people where they are, we create a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive and a workplace that reflects our values, our people, and our drive to win.

The Opportunity

About The Role

The Sr. MLOps Engineer treats ML systems as software systems and owns the path from a trained model to a production endpoint that meets its latency, cost, and reliability budgets — across both batch scoring (SageMaker Batch Transform, Snowflake Cortex / Snowpark ML, dbt-orchestrated scoring) and real-time inference (SageMaker real-time endpoints, Lambda + Bedrock, sub-second feature serving). The Sr. Engineer builds the platform that data scientists and ML engineers ship on: feature store with guaranteed online/offline parity, model registry, CI/CD for ML, drift and quality monitoring, champion/challenger and shadow deployment scaffolding. This requires a software-engineering-first mindset — distributed systems, observability, and on-call instincts are the foundation; ML literacy makes them effective for this role. GenAI integration experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Responsibilities

ML Production Platform
Stand up and operate BetMGM's ML platform on AWS (SageMaker Training, Model Registry, Pipelines, Endpoints, Batch Transform) and Snowflake (Snowpark ML, Cortex), with Terraform-managed infrastructure
Build self-service scaffolds that let data scientists ship a model end-to-end without a ticket queue — cookie-cutter project templates with CI, drift monitoring, alerting, IaC, and Snowflake connectivity pre-baked

Batch and Real-Time Inference
Design and operate batch scoring pipelines — SageMaker Batch Transform, dbt-orchestrated scoring against Snowflake, Snowpark ML — with explicit freshness and cost SLAs.
Design and operate real-time inference paths — SageMaker real-time endpoints, Lambda + Bedrock for GenAI, API Gateway — with stated latency budgets (typically sub-100ms) and graceful degradation under load.
Own the feature store (SageMaker Feature Store, Tecton, or Feast) with guaranteed online/offline parity — training-serving skew is treated as an incident, not a tradeoff.

CI/CD and Deployment Patterns
Build CI/CD for ML — model registry, automated retraining triggers, model versioning, lineage from feature → training run → deployed model → live prediction.
Implement champion/challenger, shadow deployments, and canary releases as platform primitives so individual model teams do not reinvent them per project.

Monitoring, Drift & Reliability
Stand up drift detection, data quality, and model performance monitoring (Evidently, Arize, or SageMaker Model Monitor — pick one and standardize) with paging that routes to humans who can fix it.
Own MLOps incident response — production model failures are SEV events with postmortems.

Cost and Performance
Right-size endpoints, batch caching, request batching, and autoscaling. State cost-per-prediction targets up front and meet them.

GenAI Integration (Plus, Not Required)
Integrate LLM APIs (Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI) into production paths — RAG pipelines, agent eval frameworks, prompt versioning, cost and latency observability.
Partner with the Helix team on AI personalization workloads as they ramp toward March Madness 2027.
undefined
AI in the Engineering Loop
Direct AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, dbt Copilot) as a force multiplier across infrastructure code, eval suites, and model-serving glue — designing work for agents to do, not just accepting their suggestions.

Collaboration
Partner with the data engineering team on shared standards (Terraform modules, CI/CD patterns, observability, lineage).
Work alongside data scientists and analytics partners to land the right interfaces between research and production — opinionated about the boundary.
Coordinate with Entain India and contractor ML partners as workloads consolidate onto the BetMGM-owned platform.

Qualifications
BS or MS in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Machine Learning, or other STEM field — or equivalent practical experience. Practical experience wins ties; a PhD is neither required nor a tiebreakers
Must-Haves
5+ years shipping software in production — Python, Docker, Kubernetes or ECS, CI/CD, distributed systems debugging — including time on-call.
3+ years operating ML in production — you have owned a model in prod that served real traffic, with stated latency and cost budgets and a runbook you wrote.
AWS depth across the SageMaker surface (Training, Endpoints, Batch Transform, Model Registry, Pipelines) plus the supporting cast (IAM, Lambda, ECS, S3, Secrets Manager, VPC).
Snowflake fluency — Snowpark ML, Cortex, dbt-orchestrated batch scoring, RBAC for ML workloads.
IaC for ML — Terraform + SageMaker Pipelines or equivalent. No manual console deployments to production.
Feature store experience — SageMaker Feature Store, Tecton, or Feast — with explicit ownership of online/offline parity.
Champion/challenger, shadow, and canary deployment patterns as production muscle, not blog-post familiarity.
Drift and model monitoring — Evidently, Arize, WhyLabs, or SageMaker Model Monitor — wired to a paging path.
Software-engineering-first mindset — you treat ML systems as systems, not notebooks.
Nice-to-Haves
GenAI in production — Bedrock, Anthropic, or OpenAI APIs integrated into live systems; RAG pipelines; vector DBs (Snowflake Cortex Search, pgvector, Pinecone); evaluation frameworks (Langfuse or in-house).
Snowflake-native ML — Snowpark Container Services, Cortex AISQL, Cortex Agents — for workloads that do not need to leave the warehouse.
Streaming feature engineering — Kafka, Flink, or Snowpipe Streaming — for sub-second features.
Fine-tuning experience — LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning, eval-driven iteration — with an honest read on when fine-tuning beats prompting.
A track record of shipping more with AI in the engineering loop than without.
Regulated-industry experience (gaming, fintech, healthcare) — comfort with model risk, audit, and lineage requirements.

Applicants must possess legal authorization to work for our company in the U.S. without the need for immigration sponsorship. At this time, this role is not eligible for immigration-related employment authorization sponsorship including H-1B, O-1, E-3, TN, OPT, etc.

Compensation

The pay range for this position is as follows:

117,100.00--156,200.00

Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for participation in a performance-based bonus plan.

Gaming Compliance & Licensing Requirements

As an online gaming company, BetMGM is required to comply with state gaming regulations which includes licensing obligations. Applicable employees must be licensed by at least one jurisdictional agency, although certain positions require licensing by multiple agencies. Failure to become licensed or maintain licensure with each agency as required for the role may result in termination of employment. Please note that the licensing process includes comprehensive background checks which may include a review of criminal records, financial history, and personal background verification.

In addition, candidates must comply with and support BetMGM's responsible gambling policies, procedures, and initiatives.

About BetMGM

BetMGM is revolutionizing sports betting and online gaming in the United States and Canada. We are a partnership between two powerhouse organizations—MGM Resorts International and Entain Group. You know our name through our exciting portfolio of brands including BetMGM Casino, BetMGM Sportsbook, Borgata Online, Party Casino and Party Poker. We aim to bring our ideas into action and find ways to deliver the best quality in gaming platforms.

added.title: Data Scientist
added.description:
Leads and executes deep dive diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics to support data-driven business decision making. Mentors and develops junior data scientists and analysts.

Vanguard is committed to continuous Client Experience improvement, and the Enterprise Intelligence group develops and supports a suite of internal CX analytical tools. These Data Science tools – spanning models, software, and interfaces – are used by internal Vanguard expert analysts to better understand CX outcomes. This position is for a full stack Data Scientist supporting the continued development of our internal suite of CX analytical tools. The role will be responsible for rapidly understanding the current state of those methods / models / systems, then working with existing Data Science and Machine Learning stakeholders to support and update that suite.

Applicants should have a baseline understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), deployment of code through Python packages, integration of AI into code (both in development and application), and Natural Language Processing (NLP) fundamentals for text processing & analysis. Your work will connect with subject matter experts across Data Science, Analytics, Client Experience, and Business – you’ll need to be able to cater your technical communication across audiences. You will follow the Vanguard Model Governance process and adhere to AI usage policies, protecting client information and ensuring full compliance with safety & security best practices.

You’ll be working with a highly-skilled team of Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers, on a suite of software that has moved beyond its initial development stages. This will demand rapid familiarization, the ability to quickly understand existing codebase, and finding opportunities for improvement. You will need to work with your management and stakeholders to prioritize tasking, autonomously deliver on that tasking, and proactively come back with proposed next steps.

Core Responsibilities

Deliver technology:

Build and support existing software, models, packages, and other analytics tools used for data-driven business decision making.
Implement AI prompt engineering, NLP text processing, and unstructured data modeling in systems & packages.
Deploy software to internal consumers, adhere to the PDLC process, create and use monitoring & tracking features.

Use technology responsibly:

Follow the Vanguard Model Governance methodology & process, adhering to security policies around AI usage, software design, and model validation.
Identify and diagnose data & code issues, always through continuous code review, and when necessary by performing root-cause analysis and post-mortems.
Proactively surface found issues or risks.

Manage stakeholders:

Engage with internal stakeholders (DS, MLE, Business...) to understand and probe business processes in order to improve CX models, packages, and tools.
Establish Definitions-of-Done with stakeholders, ensure that DoD is tracked and met through the PDLC process.
Communicate complex findings and implications to leaders & teammates.

Be a team player:

Mentor and develop junior data scientists and analysts.
Actively share information across workstreams, promote cross-pollination of findings & hurdles.
Participate in special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum of five years related work experience in Data Science development & modeling roles.
Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or related Data Science field of study, or equivalent combination of training and experience. Graduate degree preferred.
Experience with the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC), especially deploying Data Science tools to expert analyst users.
Proven experience using AI and NLP methods & tools to extract information from unstructured data at scale. Strong background using quantified measures to evaluate text, developing models around those measures, and improving them over time.
Advanced programming experience with Python, including deploying solutions as Packages that include telemetry feedback, safeguards, secure credentialing, and other User Access Controls (UAC).
Ability to communicate technically complex concepts across varying audiences. Know when to dive deep, and when to keep things high-level.
Some experience with data wrangling required – ability to extract, transform and load (ETL) large-scale data for statistical modeling.
Preference for candidates who have worked with Client Experience & client outcomes, who have familiarity with terminology surrounding client feedback & stories.

Special Factors

Sponsorship

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

About Vanguard

At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.

To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance
401(k) with company match
Pre-tax spending accounts including health care FSA and commuter savings
Flexible paid time off
Professional development reimbursement and ongoing skills training opportunities
Employee resource groups
Swag, ticket giveaways, and more!

At BetMGM, we recognize that every individual plays a meaningful role in our success. That’s why we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive workplace. It’s the strategy behind every win. By meeting people where they are, we create a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive and a workplace that reflects our values, our people, and our drive to win.

The Opportunity

About The Role

The Sr. MLOps Engineer treats ML systems as software systems and owns the path from a trained model to a production endpoint that meets its latency, cost, and reliability budgets — across both batch scoring (SageMaker Batch Transform, Snowflake Cortex / Snowpark ML, dbt-orchestrated scoring) and real-time inference (SageMaker real-time endpoints, Lambda + Bedrock, sub-second feature serving). The Sr. Engineer builds the platform that data scientists and ML engineers ship on: feature store with guaranteed online/offline parity, model registry, CI/CD for ML, drift and quality monitoring, champion/challenger and shadow deployment scaffolding. This requires a software-engineering-first mindset — distributed systems, observability, and on-call instincts are the foundation; ML literacy makes them effective for this role. GenAI integration experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Responsibilities

ML Production Platform
Stand up and operate BetMGM's ML platform on AWS (SageMaker Training, Model Registry, Pipelines, Endpoints, Batch Transform) and Snowflake (Snowpark ML, Cortex), with Terraform-managed infrastructure
Build self-service scaffolds that let data scientists ship a model end-to-end without a ticket queue — cookie-cutter project templates with CI, drift monitoring, alerting, IaC, and Snowflake connectivity pre-baked

Batch and Real-Time Inference
Design and operate batch scoring pipelines — SageMaker Batch Transform, dbt-orchestrated scoring against Snowflake, Snowpark ML — with explicit freshness and cost SLAs.
Design and operate real-time inference paths — SageMaker real-time endpoints, Lambda + Bedrock for GenAI, API Gateway — with stated latency budgets (typically sub-100ms) and graceful degradation under load.
Own the feature store (SageMaker Feature Store, Tecton, or Feast) with guaranteed online/offline parity — training-serving skew is treated as an incident, not a tradeoff.

CI/CD and Deployment Patterns
Build CI/CD for ML — model registry, automated retraining triggers, model versioning, lineage from feature → training run → deployed model → live prediction.
Implement champion/challenger, shadow deployments, and canary releases as platform primitives so individual model teams do not reinvent them per project.

Monitoring, Drift & Reliability
Stand up drift detection, data quality, and model performance monitoring (Evidently, Arize, or SageMaker Model Monitor — pick one and standardize) with paging that routes to humans who can fix it.
Own MLOps incident response — production model failures are SEV events with postmortems.

Cost and Performance
Right-size endpoints, batch caching, request batching, and autoscaling. State cost-per-prediction targets up front and meet them.

GenAI Integration (Plus, Not Required)
Integrate LLM APIs (Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI) into production paths — RAG pipelines, agent eval frameworks, prompt versioning, cost and latency observability.
Partner with the Helix team on AI personalization workloads as they ramp toward March Madness 2027.
undefined
AI in the Engineering Loop
Direct AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, dbt Copilot) as a force multiplier across infrastructure code, eval suites, and model-serving glue — designing work for agents to do, not just accepting their suggestions.

Collaboration
Partner with the data engineering team on shared standards (Terraform modules, CI/CD patterns, observability, lineage).
Work alongside data scientists and analytics partners to land the right interfaces between research and production — opinionated about the boundary.
Coordinate with Entain India and contractor ML partners as workloads consolidate onto the BetMGM-owned platform.

Qualifications
BS or MS in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Machine Learning, or other STEM field — or equivalent practical experience. Practical experience wins ties; a PhD is neither required nor a tiebreakers
Must-Haves
5+ years shipping software in production — Python, Docker, Kubernetes or ECS, CI/CD, distributed systems debugging — including time on-call.
3+ years operating ML in production — you have owned a model in prod that served real traffic, with stated latency and cost budgets and a runbook you wrote.
AWS depth across the SageMaker surface (Training, Endpoints, Batch Transform, Model Registry, Pipelines) plus the supporting cast (IAM, Lambda, ECS, S3, Secrets Manager, VPC).
Snowflake fluency — Snowpark ML, Cortex, dbt-orchestrated batch scoring, RBAC for ML workloads.
IaC for ML — Terraform + SageMaker Pipelines or equivalent. No manual console deployments to production.
Feature store experience — SageMaker Feature Store, Tecton, or Feast — with explicit ownership of online/offline parity.
Champion/challenger, shadow, and canary deployment patterns as production muscle, not blog-post familiarity.
Drift and model monitoring — Evidently, Arize, WhyLabs, or SageMaker Model Monitor — wired to a paging path.
Software-engineering-first mindset — you treat ML systems as systems, not notebooks.
Nice-to-Haves
GenAI in production — Bedrock, Anthropic, or OpenAI APIs integrated into live systems; RAG pipelines; vector DBs (Snowflake Cortex Search, pgvector, Pinecone); evaluation frameworks (Langfuse or in-house).
Snowflake-native ML — Snowpark Container Services, Cortex AISQL, Cortex Agents — for workloads that do not need to leave the warehouse.
Streaming feature engineering — Kafka, Flink, or Snowpipe Streaming — for sub-second features.
Fine-tuning experience — LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning, eval-driven iteration — with an honest read on when fine-tuning beats prompting.
A track record of shipping more with AI in the engineering loop than without.
Regulated-industry experience (gaming, fintech, healthcare) — comfort with model risk, audit, and lineage requirements.

Applicants must possess legal authorization to work for our company in the U.S. without the need for immigration sponsorship. At this time, this role is not eligible for immigration-related employment authorization sponsorship including H-1B, O-1, E-3, TN, OPT, etc.

117,100.00--156,200.00

added.title: Applied AI Software Engineer III
added.description:
About Us

The AI Transformation Team, part of the Applied AI Strategic Growth Market (AAI SGM), is dedicated to accelerating the adoption and delivery of agentic AI solutions within Deloitte. We work at the intersection of business and technology, rapidly evaluating, prototyping, and scaling AI-powered solutions that drive measurable value.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/04/2026.

Role Description:

The Applied AI SGM AI Transformation Team is seeking a Applied AI Software Engineer III to join our intake solutioning team for top-prioritized agentic AI solutions in our Enterprise Solutions.

You will support the end-to-end process for agentic AI solutions: use case intake, solution feasibility assessment, solution design, requirements gathering, technology and tooling selection, and initial prototyping. You will also serve as the link between business stakeholders and technical development teams, ensuring clear handoffs and robust solution foundations. This role requires a blend of traditional software engineering skills, cloud solution architecture experience, and hands-on expertise with generative AI models and agentic frameworks.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree required
5+ years of applicable experience
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Software Engineering: Strong proficiency in Python and Git, grounded in core software engineering practice including modular design, API design, testing, code review, and CI/CD.
Cloud Solution Architecture: Experience designing and deploying solutions on Azure, GCP, or AWS, including the security, integration, and cost considerations that shape design.
Design Trade-offs and Technical Judgment: Ability to translate business objectives into technical options, and to explain the effort, risk, and value of each in terms stakeholders can act on, driving decisions on scope, sequencing, and architecture.
Generative AI APIs: Hands-on experience integrating and orchestrating solutions using APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar providers.
AI Tool Experience: Hands-on experience with AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, ideally including code generation work with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.
Agentic Frameworks: Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Vertex AI Agent Development Kit, or OpenAI Agents SDK.
Solution Evaluation: Ability to assess build vs. buy decisions, evaluate risk, data requirements, ROI, and timelines.
Stakeholder Collaboration and Design Trade-offs: Experience working with business and technical stakeholders to prioritize and align solution opportunities, translating business objectives into technical options and explaining the effort, risk, and value of each in terms stakeholders can act on.
Project and Team Leadership: Experience scoping and sequencing delivery work, managing timelines across concurrent intakes, coordinating handoffs with development teams, and mentoring less experienced engineers.
Responsible AI and Risk: Familiarity with data privacy, confidentiality, and auditability requirements for enterprise AI, human-in-the-loop design, and agent-specific risks such as prompt injection and tool permission scope.
Agent Interoperability (preferred): Exposure to emerging standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) for connecting agents to enterprise tools, data sources, and other agents.
Full Solution Lifecycle (preferred): Experience taking solutions from intake through prototyping to deployment and adoption.
Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $102,500 to $210,600.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

added.description:
At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

Job Overview

The Engineer, AI develops, deploys, and supports production-grade consumer AI applications and reusable platform services powered by large language models and generative AI. The role builds backend services, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation solutions, agentic workflows, and secure integrations with enterprise systems to improve customer experiences and operational efficiency. The engineer applies software engineering fundamentals, cloud-native practices, automated testing, and AI evaluation to deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions. Working with senior engineers and cross-functional partners, this role contributes throughout the software lifecycle, including design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

Job Responsibilities
:

Build and support production LLM-powered applications, backend APIs, and reusable cloud-native AI services.
Apply prompt engineering and fine-tuning techniques to optimize AI system performance effectively
Implement agentic workflows, tool/function calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and secure enterprise API integrations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure effective integration and functionality of AI systems
Develop automated tests, AI evaluations, observability, and production reliability improvements for deployed AI solutions.
Contribute to strategic AI initiatives that advance organizational goals of customer satisfaction and efficiency
Also responsible for other duties/projects as assigned by business management as needed

Required Education and Work Experience
:

Bachelor's Degree plus 3 years of related work experience OR advanced degree with 3 year of related work experience OR a combination of education and experience deemed equivalent. (Required)
Acceptable areas of study include Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or Related Field (Preferred)
1-2 years Experience building production LLM applications with RAG, structured outputs, and AI evaluation or regression testing. (Preferred)
1-2 years Experience with agentic AI frameworks, tool/function calling, MCP, or conversational and multimodal AI. (Preferred)
2-4 years Developing and deploying machine learning models, including fine-tuning and prompt engineering (Preferred)
2-4 years Experience with AI tools and software development using programming languages such as Python or R (Preferred)
2-4 years Collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into business workflows (Preferred)

Required Skills
:

Cloud Computing (Required)
Collaboration (Required)
Customer-Focused (Required)
Data Analysis (Required)
Data Management (Required)
Data Modeling (Required)
Model Tuning (Required)
Prompt Engineering (Required)
LLM Application Development: Experience with prompt engineering, RAG, context management, structured outputs, and evaluation. (Preferred)
Agentic AI and Tool Integration: Familiarity with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, workflow state, and enterprise integrations. (Preferred)
Cloud-Native AI Operations: Familiarity with containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, and production troubleshooting. (Preferred)

Licenses and Certifications
:

Certified Analytics Professional (CAP): Certification that validates an individual's expertise in data analytics processes, including the ability to model and interpret complex data. (Preferred)
Machine Learning Certification: Certification demonstrating proficiency in machine learning techniques and applications, relevant for developing AI models. (Preferred)
Certified Data Scientist (CDS): Certification that endorses skills in data science and its application in AI modeling, crucial for enhancing AI-driven customer service solutions. (Preferred)
At least 18 years of age
Legally authorized to work in the United States

:

:

added.title: AI Engineer, Forward Deployed (Copilot and Azure AI Foundry)
added.description:
Role Overview

The AI Engineer is a hands-on builder who works directly with Client teams to design, build, and ship production AI solutions on Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Azure AI Foundry (now Microsoft Foundry). This is an individual contributor role. You will write the code, configure the agents, wire up the data, and get solutions into the hands of real users.

You will work inside a Collectiv delivery team alongside a project lead, architects, and data engineers. You will partner directly with Client business and IT stakeholders to turn a business problem into a working AI solution, then harden it for production.

Key Responsibilities

Copilot Solutions

Build declarative agents, Copilot connectors, and plugins that extend Microsoft 365 Copilot with Client data and workflows
Build Copilot Studio agents, topics, actions, and autonomous agents for business processes
Connect Copilot to SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft Graph, Dataverse, and line-of-business systems
Write and iterate on prompts, instructions, and agent configurations based on test results and user feedback

Azure AI Foundry Solutions

Build custom agents and AI applications in Azure AI Foundry for use cases that go beyond out-of-the-box Copilot
Select, deploy, and configure models from the Foundry model catalog, and explain the trade-offs in cost, quality, and latency
Implement agentic workflows with tool calling, multi-step orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems through APIs, Azure Functions, Power Automate, and Logic Apps

Retrieval and Data Foundations

Build end-to-end retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines including ingestion, chunking, embedding, vector and hybrid search, and grounding
Use Azure AI Search and Azure AI Document Intelligence to index and extract knowledge from Client content
Partner with Collectiv data engineers to connect AI solutions to Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, and other enterprise data platforms

Evaluation and Production Readiness

Build evaluation sets and test harnesses that measure answer quality, groundedness, hallucination rate, safety, latency, and cost
Implement logging, monitoring, and tracing for deployed agents and models
Apply security, identity, and governance controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Purview, and Azure AI Content Safety
Use version control, CI/CD, and code review standards for all AI solution code and configuration

Consulting and Collaboration

Work directly with Client stakeholders to gather requirements, run working sessions, demo progress, and manage expectations
Translate business problems into scoped, buildable AI use cases with clear success metrics
Train Client users and administrators on the solutions you build and support adoption after go-live
Contribute reusable patterns, accelerators, and documentation to Collectiv's AI practice

Eligibility for this engagement

This engagement requires US citizenship under the client's contract terms. This is a condition of the specific client project, not a Collectiv policy; Collectiv regularly hires non-US citizens and people based outside the US for other roles.
You must be physically located in the United States for the duration of the engagement.
If you do not meet these two conditions, please still apply: we will keep your application active for AI Engineer roles that do not carry this requirement and contact you directly when one opens.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
4+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or Microsoft 365 and Power Platform development
1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying generative AI or LLM-powered solutions in production or Client environments
Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility and Copilot Studio
Hands-on experience with Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI
Experience building RAG solutions with Azure AI Search
Strong Python or C# skills
Experience working in Azure (storage, compute, identity, networking)
Ability to work independently in a Client-facing consulting role

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen
Experience with Power Platform, Dataverse, and Power Automate
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Power BI
Experience with LLMOps practices including evaluation frameworks, prompt management, and model monitoring
Familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerations for AI in regulated industries
Consulting experience across multiple Clients or industries
Relevant certifications such as Azure AI Engineer Associate, Copilot Studio or Power Platform certifications, or Fabric (DP-600, DP-700)

What Success Looks Like In This Role

AI solutions you build reach production and are used by real people, not just demoed
Clients trust you as the engineer who knows how to make Copilot and Foundry work in their environment
Your solutions are measured, documented, secure, and supportable after handoff
You contribute patterns and accelerators that make Collectiv's next AI engagement faster

Why Collectiv

Join Collectiv for a rewarding career in a fully remote work environment with quarterly in-person team Experiences and competitive compensation. We provide a clear growth trajectory with professional development opportunities and a top-shelf benefits package. Enjoy unlimited time off and 100% covered health insurance, encompassing medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family. Our comprehensive offerings, from a competitive 401(k) with a 4% match to educational assistance, tech stipend, and discounts on various goods and services, demonstrate our commitment to your well-being and success.

Collectiv is the leading boutique consulting and strategy firm specializing in Analytics, Planning, and AI with Power BI and the Microsoft data stack.

Our mission at Collectiv is simple: We help enterprises break free from stagnation and make better decisions.

Our Core Values

Growth Mindset: Bring solutions, not problems.
Excel with Humility: Be humbly brilliant.
Communicate Actively and Empathetically: Listen, ask, understand, help.
Work Hard, Play Hard: Results are proportional to effort.
Keep Calm and Carry On: Stay cool, calm, and Collectiv.

added.title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
added.description:
ABOUT US:

Founded in 2020, Regal is the AI Agent Platform. Regal gives every company the tools to transform customer communications with delightful AI Agents that are connected to your data, easy to customize and monitor, always-available, and ready to take action. Power better support, sales and operations – with way less effort. Our founders, Alex Levin and Rebecca Greene helped build Angi (Angie’s List, HomeAdvisor and Handy) to over $1.5B in revenue.

Based in Manhattan, we’re building an in-person culture of entrepreneurs who want to win and build something meaningful. We’re backed by top investors including Founder Collective, Homebrew and Emergence Capital.

Come join us as we create a category-defining company, and follow Regal's company page on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our journey and current job openings!

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an AI Forward Deployed Engineer at Regal you’re the product owner of each customer’s onboarding journey. Imagine taking the reins of a micro “product launch” for every new customer. You’ll be responsible for bringing our Voice AI Agents to life in production.

This role is for someone who doesn’t know the meaning of “not my problem.” You take end-to-end ownership, step into ambiguity, and do what it takes to move customers forward. It’s a unique opportunity to work with founders at the forefront of AI innovation and define the next generation of customer experiences.

If you love operating at the intersection of technical execution and product strategy—turning business objectives into real product experiences and approaching each deployment like a tightly scoped MVP—this role was built for you.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Accelerate Customer Deployments: Execute end-to-end deployments by treating onboarding as a mini product cycle, integrating AI Agents seamlessly into customer systems and workflows to move the needle on key business metrics
Own the Product Vision (Per Deployment): Collaborate with customers to understand their goals, success criteria, and operational context. Then, translate these insights into a clear, measurable deployment plan that aligns Regal’s capabilities with their strategic objectives
Architect Technical Integrations: Work hands-on with APIs, webhooks, and databases to seamlessly integrate Regal into the customer’s existing systems
Shape Conversational Experiences: Work internally with Regal AI Product Specialists to guide the creation and refinement of voice prompts and AI agent settings to achieve the conversational quality that is Regal’s signature
Measure, iterate, and adapt: Build reporting to measure AI Agent performance, partner with customers to refine post-call analysis, and create a roadmap of A/B tests to continuously improve accuracy and outcomes
Stakeholder Management: Provide weekly status updates, manage timelines, and communicate proactively with both internal and external stakeholders. Mitigate risks, reprioritize as needed, and keep everyone aligned around the deployment roadmap
Unlock Future Value: As customers gain confidence, surface new use cases and features that can drive ongoing value. Use your product and commercial mindset to spot expansion opportunities and ensure each deployment isn’t just a one-off success, but the start of a long-term partnership

ABOUT YOU:

Technical Chops: 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., Solutions Engineer, Implementation Consultant or a PM in a tech environment). Comfort working with APIs, writing a bit of middleware code when needed, and framing product capabilities for executive stakeholders
Strategic Problem-Solving: You look beyond the immediate ask, synthesizing business needs, user experience, and platform constraints into a cohesive product vision—and executing on it
Outstanding Communication: Whether you’re writing a project brief, presenting call flow diagrams, or explaining data integration steps to a CTO, you tailor your message and ensure everyone understands the big picture
Relentless Ownership: “Not my problem” isn’t in your vocabulary. You’re accountable for the success of each deployment, making smart trade-offs, iterating quickly, and doing whatever it takes to ship on time
Curiosity for AI & Voice: You’re excited about the potential of Voice AI. Maybe you’ve dabbled in conversational design, prompt engineering, or user research for voice interfaces. You’re eager to learn more and push the envelope on what’s possible
Entrepreneurial DNA: You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where you can shape processes, influence product direction, and drive revenue. Your adaptability and growth mindset help you navigate change and complexity with ease.
Ability to travel: You should expect to travel 1 week per month. When launching a new customer, you’ll travel to their office (if they are in person), and periodically thereafter to meet with execs

BENEFITS/PERKS:

We care about your health!
Medical, Dental, and Vision plans - 80% covered by the company
Flexible PTO & 11 paid holidays/year
Subsidized ClassPass membership
We care about future you!
401k Plan
Paid parental leave
Pre-tax commuter benefits
We care about connection!
In-office breakfast and snacks daily
Happy hours, team outings, & annual off-sites
Complete laptop workstation
& more to come!

POSITION LOCATION & OFFICE DETAILS:

This position is only available in New York City (HQ- NoMad). Hybrid roles are required in office T/W/TH and encouraged 5x/week.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

All offers include a competitive equity package and some offers may additionally include a variable compensation component. Actual compensation is determined on an individualized basis taking into consideration factors such as the candidate's skills, location, qualifications, experience, and relevant education or training. In addition, Regal offers a comprehensive set of employee benefits which are listed above. Details about the compensation package will be finalized at the time of offer.

added.description:
Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane
, and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane
—a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable
.

Our mission
is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents
. We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.

Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies
and platform engineers across 100+ countries
. Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads
and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide
. We’re a Series B
company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital
, and we’ve raised $69M
to date. Learn more at upbound.io
.

As a Staff Solutions Architect at Upbound, you own the technical success of our customers. You are the primary driver of customer outcomes, from initial implementation through production adoption, ensuring customers achieve real business value with Crossplane and the Upbound platform. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role embedded in the post-sales motion
, working closely with customers to deliver working solutions, not just guidance.

In This Role, You Will Own

Customer Technical Outcomes

Drive end-to-end technical success for a portfolio of enterprise customers, from post-sales handoff through production adoption.
Own the implementation of known Upbound use cases — control plane architectures, Upbound/Crossplane configurations, GitOps integration, platform engineering patterns — and ensure customers reach their target state.
Define and track technical milestones that map to customer business objectives and contract value.
Act as the primary technical escalation point when customers face blockers, coordinating engineering and product resources to resolve them.

Implementation & Architecture

Lead technical discovery to deeply understand customer environments, platform requirements, and target architecture.
Design and deliver Crossplane-based control plane architectures tailored to customer infrastructure and organizational context.
Build and maintain reference platforms and implementation accelerators that codify Upbound best practices and reduce time-to-value for common use cases.
Contribute Statements of Work that accurately scope implementation engagements.
Write code, fix bugs, and build scoped features within Upbound products, provider ecosystem, and Crossplane core where needed to unblock customers.

Technical Voice of the Customer

Represent customer technical needs internally to influence product roadmap and prioritization.
Partner with pre-sales SEs to ensure smooth, informed handoffs with full context on customer environment and expectations.
Identify expansion opportunities as customer technical maturity grows and new Upbound capabilities become relevant.

You Are a Good Fit If You Have

Hands-on Kubernetes expertise — operators, controllers, or add-ons; production deployment and management experience.
Platform engineering or SRE background, with direct experience building or operating an Internal Developer Platform (IDP).
Deep familiarity with cloud-native tooling: CNCF ecosystem, IaC (Terraform/Pulumi), GitOps (Flux/ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines.
Experience across at least two major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) at production scale.
Strong programming skills; Go is strongly preferred.
Proven track record of leading customers through complex technical implementations to successful, measurable outcomes.
Excellent communication skills — comfortable presenting architecture and trade-offs to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
Able to manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously in a fast-moving startup environment.

It Is a Plus If

Crossplane power user — contributions to core or the provider ecosystem are very appreciated [for many reasons]
Active Kubernetes community involvement: contributions, conference talks, technical writing, or open source maintainership.
CKA or CKAD certification.
Prior startup, familiarity with coding agents and distributed team experience.

Why Upbound?

At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

About Upbound

Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io.

As a Staff Solutions Architect at Upbound, you own the technical success of our customers. You are the primary driver of customer outcomes, from initial implementation through production adoption, ensuring customers achieve real business value with Crossplane and the Upbound platform. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role embedded in the post-sales motion
, working closely with customers to deliver working solutions, not just guidance.

In This Role, You Will Own

Customer Technical Outcomes

Drive end-to-end technical success for a portfolio of enterprise customers, from post-sales handoff through production adoption.
Own the implementation of known Upbound use cases — control plane architectures, Upbound/Crossplane configurations, GitOps integration, platform engineering patterns — and ensure customers reach their target state.
Define and track technical milestones that map to customer business objectives and contract value.
Act as the primary technical escalation point when customers face blockers, coordinating engineering and product resources to resolve them.

Implementation & Architecture

Lead technical discovery to deeply understand customer environments, platform requirements, and target architecture.
Design and deliver Crossplane-based control plane architectures tailored to customer infrastructure and organizational context.
Build and maintain reference platforms and implementation accelerators that codify Upbound best practices and reduce time-to-value for common use cases.
Contribute Statements of Work that accurately scope implementation engagements.
Write code, fix bugs, and build scoped features within Upbound products, provider ecosystem, and Crossplane core where needed to unblock customers.

Technical Voice of the Customer

Represent customer technical needs internally to influence product roadmap and prioritization.
Partner with pre-sales SEs to ensure smooth, informed handoffs with full context on customer environment and expectations.
Identify expansion opportunities as customer technical maturity grows and new Upbound capabilities become relevant.

You Are a Good Fit If You Have

Hands-on Kubernetes expertise — operators, controllers, or add-ons; production deployment and management experience.
Platform engineering or SRE background, with direct experience building or operating an Internal Developer Platform (IDP).
Deep familiarity with cloud-native tooling: CNCF ecosystem, IaC (Terraform/Pulumi), GitOps (Flux/ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines.
Experience across at least two major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) at production scale.
Strong programming skills; Go is strongly preferred.
Proven track record of leading customers through complex technical implementations to successful, measurable outcomes.
Excellent communication skills — comfortable presenting architecture and trade-offs to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
Able to manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously in a fast-moving startup environment.

It Is a Plus If

Crossplane power user — contributions to core or the provider ecosystem are very appreciated [for many reasons]
Active Kubernetes community involvement: contributions, conference talks, technical writing, or open source maintainership.
CKA or CKAD certification.
Prior startup, familiarity with coding agents and distributed team experience.

Why Upbound?

At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.

About Upbound

Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries. The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents. Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date. For more information, visit www.upbound.io.

Title: Sr. Platform Engineer (AI/ML)

Location: Hybrid(New Orleans, LA or Houston, TX)

Duration: Full time/Long-term

We are seeking an experienced Cloud Platform Engineer to lead AI/ML platform engineering across AWS Bedrock and CoPilot (Azure) environments, drive cloud platform ownership using DevOps and Agile practices, and build scalable solutions supporting analytics, automation, and Generative AI capabilities for internal teams.

Responsibilities

Define and execute a multi-cloud roadmap aligning AWS and Azure capabilities with enterprise business goals and technical requirements.

Working knowledge across core technology domains, including infrastructure, applications, software development, end-user platforms, and IT operations.

New York, 1745 Broadway, United States

remote

Company Description

Penguin Random House is the leading adult and children's publishing house in North America, the United Kingdom and many other regions around the world. In publishing the best books in every genre and subject for all ages, we are committed to quality, excellence in execution, and innovation throughout the entire publishing process: editorial, design, marketing, publicity, sales, production, and distribution. Our vibrant and diverse international community of nearly 300 publishing brands and imprints include Ballantine Bantam Dell, Berkley, Clarkson Potter, Crown, DK, Doubleday, Dutton, Grosset & Dunlap, Little Golden Books, Knopf, Modern Library, Pantheon, Penguin Books, Penguin Press, Penguin Random House Audio, Penguin Young Readers, Portfolio, Puffin, Putnam, Random House, Random House Children's Books, Riverhead, Ten Speed Press, Viking, and Vintage, among others. More information can be found at http://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/.

Penguin Random House values the array of talents and perspectives that a diverse workforce brings. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Job Description

The Data Science team at Penguin Random House builds recommendation systems, forecasting models, and AI-powered tools that shape how readers discover books across our platforms. Our team of scientists and engineers develops and operates these systems end-to-end, from research through production.

We are building a dedicated cloud environment on AWS, along with ML platforms that enable our scientists to deliver models to production quickly. We are hiring a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to build and maintain the foundational systems that support this work.

You will build on a mature MLOps foundation and work closely with AI to evolve and run our cloud platform.

Key Responsibilities:

Design and own core components of our AWS environment used across data science products. Set the standards for how people and AI agents change infrastructure: review, tests and guardrails.
Build self-service paths to production for scientists: CI/CD pipelines, promotion gates, and automated triggers, so scientists can ship models without hand-holding.
Help maintain the security, compliance, and reliability of cloud environments.
Shape the platform roadmap by identifying the infrastructure work that will most unblock our scientists, and keep stakeholders informed as it progresses.

Qualifications

5+ years building and running production systems.
Track record of designing infrastructure components or tooling that other engineers or teams adopted.
Hands-on cloud experience (AWS preferred).
You can use AI agents to build and operate systems, and you can show work you shipped this way.
Strong communication skills and ability to work closely with data scientists and engineers.
Experience running infrastructure for ML or data-intensive workloads in production, such as model training, batch scoring or model serving.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience defining SLOs or SLAs and managing cloud cost for ML production systems.
Experience with evaluation or error analysis of ML or LLM systems in production.

Additional Information

The salary range for this position is $185,000-$210,000.
All positions are currently eligible for an annual profit award or bonus, subject to Company results.

Applications for this role will be accepted through December 3, 2026, or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we review applications on a rolling basis. For this position a complete application should include your resume and cover letter, as both are required for consideration. CFD Propulsion Research Engineer

Company:
Altus Engineering

Location:
Aberdeen Proving Ground, MD

Salary:
$100,000-$200,000

Position Overview:
Altus Engineering is currently seeking a Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Propulsion Research Engineer to support modeling, simulation, and analysis of propulsion systems including gun, rocket, and air-breathing technologies.

About Us: Founded in 2003, Altus Engineering is a Maryland-based small business providing professional engineering services to the Department of Defense and industry customers. These include high-quality software development services, system modeling and simulation, scientific research, and performing engineering analysis of combat systems and personnel vulnerabilities.
